package rulefixtures

import (
	"fmt"

	"github.com/gin-gonic/gin"
)

// scenario for operational_command_handlers_reuse_http_services_without_adapter: CLI or cron entrypoints that import Gin-only service contracts.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: info.

type GinUserService struct {
	ctx *gin.Context
}

func (s *GinUserService) GetActiveUsers() ([]string, error) {
	tenantID := s.ctx.Query("tenant_id")
	if tenantID == "" {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("missing tenant_id")
	}
	return []string{"alice", "bob"}, nil
}

func CronSyncUsers(svc *GinUserService) {
	users, err := svc.GetActiveUsers()
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Printf("sync error: %v\n", err)
		return
	}
	for _, user := range users {
		fmt.Printf("syncing user: %s\n", user)
	}
}
